title: [review] duty_cycle.rs: Potential u32 truncation in retry_after_ms calcula
description: Cast (next_tx - now_ms) as u32 can truncate if difference exceeds u32::MAX (~49 days in ms). When next_tx saturates to u64::MAX (via saturating_add on extreme timestamps near u64::MAX), the subtraction yields a huge value that truncates to garbage. Consider clamping to u32::MAX or returning None for unreasonably large delays.
